Compute the Gini coefficient/index for a numeric vector x.

Source: R/count_sgRNA.R
gini_index2.Rd

Calculate Gini index - MAGeCK alike (same results as MAGeCK, no count normalization - only log2 transform). The Gini index is a measure of statistical dispersion that represents the inequality among values of a frequency distribution. It ranges from 0 (perfect equality) to 1 (perfect inequality).

Usage

gini_index2(
  x,
  normalize_counts = FALSE,
  log_transform = TRUE,
  na.rm = TRUE,
  allow.negative = FALSE,
  digits = 4
)

Arguments

x

numeric vector (sgRNA counts). Non-negative values expected.

normalize_counts

A logical indicating whether to normalize

log_transform

A logical indicating whether to log2-transform the values in x (default is TRUE).

na.rm

logical; remove NA pairs (x and w) before computing. Default TRUE.

allow.negative

logical; if FALSE (default) stops when x has negatives. If TRUE, it will shift x by adding -min(x) (so smallest becomes 0). (Shifting changes the Gini interpretation — use with care.)

digits

numeric; round to the specified number of decimal places.

Value

numeric scalar in [0,1] (or NaN if undefined)
